subject: computer-science
title: Distributed Databases and NoSQL
welcome_lead: Scale across servers and pick the right NoSQL family for your data shape.
meta_desc: HL CS adventure on distributed databases and NoSQL families: document, key-value, graph.
final_note: CAP says: pick two - consistency, availability, partition tolerance!

concepts.def: Copies of data on several nodes.
Partitioning data across nodes by key.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Hash user_id and route writes to shard.

Spreads load; queries that hit one shard scale linearly.

Network partitions force a choice.

Banks favour CP, social feeds favour AP.

Caching: key-value. Catalog: document.

Social network: graph. Choose to fit access pattern.
